steps.en: OCMS uses the latest mobile number held by the government data source.
steps.id: OCMS memakai nomor mobile terbaru dari sumber data pemerintah.
steps.why_en: The refresh from the data source is switched off, so the stored number is used instead.
steps.why_id: Penyegaran dari sumber data dimatikan, jadi yang dipakai nomor yang tersimpan.

steps.en: Notices of the same hirer are combined into one message.
steps.id: Notice milik hirer yang sama digabung menjadi satu pesan.
steps.why_en: Notices with different due dates are not combined, so one hirer can get several messages.
steps.why_id: Notice dengan tanggal jatuh tempo berbeda tidak digabung, jadi satu hirer bisa menerima beberapa pesan.

steps.en: The message names the outstanding notices and mentions the 2nd letter.
steps.id: Pesan menyebut notice yang belum dibayar dan merujuk surat kedua.
steps.why_en: The message wording is kept as system data, so what it says cannot be confirmed.
steps.why_id: Kalimat pesan disimpan sebagai data sistem, jadi isinya tidak bisa dipastikan.

steps.en: OCMS sends the SMS to the hirer in a batch run.
steps.id: OCMS mengirim SMS ke hirer dalam batch.
steps.why_en: The batch job and SMS sending are both switched off in production, so no SMS goes out.
steps.why_id: Job batch dan pengiriman SMS sama-sama dimatikan di production, jadi SMS tidak terkirim.
